test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**refers**" is commonly followed by the preposition "**to**" in standard English usage.
 
• The phrase "**refers to**" means "to mention" or "to be about" something, which fits the context of introducing the definition of opera.
 
• Other prepositions like "**on**", "**for**", and "**with**" are grammatically incorrect after "refers" in this context.
 
• Hence, the appropriate phrase is "**Opera refers to** a dramatic art form..."

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *Opera refers to__ a dramatic art form, originating in Europe, in which the emotional content is conveyed to the audience...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **On**: Generally used to indicate position or surface—e.g., "on the table."
 
• **For**: Used to indicate purpose—e.g., "This is for you."
 
• **With**: Indicates association or instrumentality—e.g., "He came with his friend."
